qualification: Invented byte ingress/parser data only. No encoder, issuer, policy, collection, SQL, acknowledgement, runtime or device acceptance.

coverage.sourceTest: independent Python vectors pin raw exact byte SHA, LF domains and framed metadata request digests in source/compiled consumers
semantically equal whitespace/escape/-0 representations preserve different originals and cannot share a request digest
receipt shapes match only exact original data; all outcomes remain data and never acknowledge
every original binding field contributes to identity without normalization or namespace/authority substitution
strict original raw JSON rejects root and nested escaped duplicate keys before frozen semantics
strict UTF8/Unicode/BOM/depth resource boundaries distinguish valid string content from invalid documents
raw observation cap is independent, exact and never truncates or reserializes retained bytes
actual transport byte ceiling and object-local producer output budgets are independent and explicitly bounded
one entire batch shares wire budget and scoped identities; no independent per-item cap multiplication
descriptor validation is data only, with explicit references and booleans, no missing-policy defaults or frozen-producer change
proxies, getters, executable/non-JSON values and hostile byte accessors cannot execute during admission
producer-owned escape-heavy full batches meet exact cap +/-1 and oversized ingress never decodes Base64
producing schema independently rejects contradictory receipt outcome/code/durability data
producing schema independently rejects enrollment state/namespace contradictions
wire revisions: fractional binding tokens cannot round into an existing valid integer digest
wire revisions: descriptor revisions must retain their exact mathematical integer value
wire revisions: near-safeinteger fractional tokens cannot borrow a safeinteger digest
wire revisions: exact integer spellings stay valid; raw Location fractions remain original byte data

rowFormat.nullRules: Carrier originals null unless admitted contract; items always array(empty whennotapplicable/rejected); receipt fields/match null whennotapplicable. Input bytes always from actual expanded test input. Base64 metric counts primary input parser only, not optional original-item matcher parse.
